Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on the 29th March 2004, the matter described above is not lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:

The proposed outbuilding does not fall within Class E Part 1 Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because due to its location and the location of other outbuildings within the subject property, its volume would count towards the dwelling's permitted development allowance.  The total volume of the proposed outbuilding along with all other applicable outbuildings and additions would exceed the maximum permitted development volume of 50 cubic metres for development to a terraced dwelling.  A planning application would therefore be required.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of single storey detached building in rear end of garden to dwellinghouse for use as playroom.
